title: Object channel eligibility predicate
summary: Recovered VA 0x443110 (43 bytes): require flags at +0x174 to contain bits 0, 1 and 2, then test channel_mask at +0x4c using channel modulo 32. Read-only bool fastcall member (ECX object, EDX channel, AL result), supported by four direct callers.
test_description: Compare original and recovered predicate for every flag byte, every single-bit mask plus zero/all/alternating masks, all channels 0..31 and wraparound/high-bit edge indices. Independently assert predicate result and compare every object byte after each call, including unknown fields and padding.
known_limits: Original class identity and meanings of the three required flag bits remain unresolved; field names are descriptive.
Only the observed partial layout is modeled; total original object size is unknown.
Null or invalid object pointers are outside the valid-input contract.
No matching-byte claim; original incidental upper EAX bits are not part of the bool result.
